raw.details:
Welcome to Prajwalan - 2K26 , an exciting competitive programming contest organized by the ACM Student Chapter, Ramdeobaba University (RBU).

This is your chance to test your problem-solving skills, sharpen your knowledge of Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA), and compete with fellow coding enthusiasts. Get ready to challenge your limits, think logically, and showcase your coding brilliance!

This festive season, let your code shine and your logic lead the way!

Event Details

  • Event Name: Prajwalan - 2K26
  • Organized By: ACM Student Chapter, Ramdeobaba University (RBU)
  • Event Type: Competitive Programming Contest
  • Mode: Online
  • Participation: Individual
  • Duration: 2 Hours
  • Number of Problems: 6 (5 Mandatory + 1 Optional Bonus Question)
  • Difficulty Level: Easy to Hard

Contest Format

  • The contest will consist of a single round lasting 2 hours.
  • Participants will receive 6 programming questions in total, out of which 5 questions are mandatory, while 1 Bonus question is completely optional and can be attempted for additional advantage.
  • Problems will range from easy to hard, offering a challenge for participants with different levels of experience.
  • Participants may use any programming language supported by the contest platform.
  • All submissions must be made through Unstop within the allotted contest duration.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to college students across institutions.
  • Both undergraduate and postgraduate students are eligible.
  • Participation is strictly individual.
  • Team participation is not permitted.

How to Participate

  1. Register for the contest through Unstop.
  2. Read the contest instructions carefully before participating.
  3. Join the official WhatsApp group for announcements and updates.
  4. Log in to Unstop before the contest begins.
  5. Attempt and submit your solutions within the contest duration.

Rules and Regulations

  • Standard competitive programming rules will apply.
  • Participants must work independently.
  • Plagiarism, copying solutions, and unauthorized external assistance are strictly prohibited.
  • All submissions must be completed within the specified contest duration.
  • Participants are responsible for ensuring a stable internet connection and a working coding environment.
  • In case of a tie, the earliest correct submission will be given preference, subject to the contest platform's scoring rules.
  • The organizers reserve the right to make decisions regarding contest conduct and rule violations.

Communication and Support

Official WhatsApp Group: 

 https://chat.whatsapp.com/Fitsy20La4HG0du0HqduHh

Contest links, announcements, and important updates will be communicated through the official WhatsApp group, registered email addresses, the university website, and official social media channels.

Technical support will be available during the contest, subject to organizer availability. Any additional contact information will be shared with registered participants if required.

Get Ready to Code!

Prepare your algorithms, sharpen your problem-solving skills, and get ready for an exciting coding experience at Prajwalan - 2K26

Think Smart. Code Fast. Compete Hard. Let Your Logic Shine!
